tasks.title: M0 Baseline closure: verified supplement, RH_001 v3, revised pitch, build/test lineage
tasks.description: Close PRD §2: import publisher-verified supplement bytes, supersede RH_001 with genotype-verification and viability/death/division requirements, revise pitch sentence 15, rebuild Stages 06-09, pass the pitch check, record build/test commits.
tasks.details: Record original, received (INTEGRITY_MISMATCH) and derived artifacts separately (FR-044). Package candidate with manifest. Existing frozen runs and superseded records stay immutable.

tasks.title: Stage 10 domain schemas
tasks.description: Pydantic contracts for ProspectivePlan, BaselineRef, Hypothesis, ExperimentSpec, EndpointSpec, Forecast, Observation, DecisionRule, DecisionRecord, SimulationRun, ResearchTask, ReviewRecord (PRD §13).
tasks.details: Typed statements (FR-001), scope fields (FR-002), distinct uncertainty states and null-with-reason numerics (FR-003), endpoint-specific results (FR-004), independence groups (FR-006), forecast modes and null probability with reason (FR-011/012), temporal status and evaluation modes (FR-014/015), lifecycle and execution states (§14). Immutable IDs plus version IDs with parent and change reason (§13.1).

tasks.title: Canonicalization, content digests and immutable version store
tasks.description: Documented canonical JSON algorithm; raw-byte hashes separate from semantic digests; atomic writes; idempotent re-import; version preconditions and conflict-with-diff (§13.1, §17).
tasks.details: Frozen payloads immutable; a change creates a successor with parent version and machine-readable reason. Competing edits on the same version return a conflict (AT23). Identical evidence imported twice keeps one identity (AT15).

tasks.title: Baseline import and verification
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective init --baseline PATH: verify package manifest, schema versions, run IDs and visibility; pin BaselineRef; show candidate/frozen status and limitations (§6.1).
tasks.details: AT01 (23 entries verify for r2/r3), AT02 (a changed byte or digest blocks verified import and freeze). Reads only sanitized artifacts.

tasks.title: Policy adapter and permissions
tasks.description: Actor types and roles (§3), separate read/draft/review/freeze/private-export/external-send permissions enforced in the domain layer; external send and remote execution disabled (FR-050..053).
tasks.details: An agent cannot sign as a human reviewer. Untrusted document text cannot change policy (AT22). Policy decisions go to an audit log without sensitive payloads.

tasks.title: MVA seed plan: H01-H07, EXP01-EXP03, endpoints, forecasts
tasks.description: Seed the MVA_001/RH_001 plan from the corrected baseline with the hypothesis set (§7), experiment specifications (§8) and qualitative conditional forecasts (§9).
tasks.details: Unresolved assay thresholds, model availability and reviews are named with owner and reason; probabilities null with reason (AT24); model applicability labels distinct (exact allele / complete genotype / generic deficient). Plan stays DRAFT/REVIEW_REQUIRED.

tasks.title: Three-valued predicate engine and branch evaluator B00-B15
tasks.description: Evaluate observation vectors with TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN predicates; missing required data yields UNKNOWN; all matches preserved; precedence and conflicts per §10.1; DecisionRecord per §10.2.
tasks.details: Adverse flag always creates hold-and-review even if unverified; quality gates decide admissibility; contradictory actions produce DECISION_REVIEW_REQUIRED; unmodelled results create a model-revision task. AT04-AT13, AT26, AT27. Deterministic replay.

tasks.title: Observation intake
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective ingest: store the immutable original result, verify identity/provenance, unit and denominator checks, classify the observation vector, produce a review proposal (§6.7, §13.2).
tasks.details: Reject incompatible units and missing denominators, never impute zero (AT14); synthetic fixtures cannot be promoted to real evidence (AT19); re-ingesting identical evidence does not duplicate or add independence (AT15).

tasks.title: Scenario explorer preview
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective preview PLAN --scenario PATH: evaluate hypothetical inputs, show matches, unknowns, next actions and which assumptions matter, clearly labelled Hypothetical scenario (FR-020).
tasks.details: Never mutates the case or evidence store and never sends anything (AT18). Supports positive, negative, partial, adverse, inconclusive and unexpected inputs.

tasks.title: Readiness validation and freeze gates
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective validate/freeze: structural, scientific-readiness, provenance and policy errors reported separately; freeze refused while required thresholds are null or reviews missing (FR-040/041).
tasks.details: Draft export allowed but marked incomplete (AT03). Outcome-availability declaration and TEMPORAL_STATUS_UNVERIFIED (AT25). Freezing a synthetic fixture never preregisters a real experiment.

tasks.title: Review, decision records and successor versions
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective review DECISION: record authorized human interpretation (accept/amend with reason/request clarification/defer) and task proposals; successor plans for post-freeze changes (FR-042).
tasks.details: Post-result amendments labelled retrospective for affected forecasts; original scoring preserved (AT16). Two reviewers on one version produce a conflict (AT23). Human judgement is a separate event from rule evaluation.

tasks.title: Diff and dependency impact report
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective diff OLD NEW: scientific vs editorial vs operational changes; baseline changes produce an impact report and review invalidation for the successor (FR-043, §16.5).
tasks.details: A changed sentence that changes scope is a scientific change. AT17.

tasks.title: Capability requests and node query drafts
tasks.description: Extend NodeQuerySpecification with FIND_EXISTING_RESULT, ASSESS_MODEL_AVAILABILITY, ASSESS_ASSAY_CAPABILITY, REQUEST_FEASIBILITY_ESTIMATE as unsent drafts; response states per FR-031; EvidenceEnvelope schema (FR-032).
tasks.details: No relevant cases or access denied is operational, never MEASURED_NO_EFFECT (AT13). Nothing is sent in this deployment.

tasks.title: Export with output policy
tasks.description: rarepipe prospective export PLAN --visibility public|private: allowlist plus leakage review over structured and free text, complete manifest, atomic write (FR-053, §13.1).
tasks.details: A synthetic private marker in free text is rejected or removed with a logged reason (AT21). No raw variant, reversible encoding, low-entropy genotype hash or nearest-known-variant clue in public output.

tasks.title: CLI and internal service interface
tasks.description: Wire init/validate/preview/freeze/ingest/review/diff/export as rarepipe prospective commands, and the same operations as an internal service interface with idempotency keys and version preconditions (§17).
tasks.details: Mutations atomic; failed builds do not advance the active plan pointer.

tasks.title: Frontend views
tasks.description: Offline HTML views generated from the same records: doctor view, operator plan editor/readiness, scenario explorer, result review, change and audit view (§16).
tasks.details: Doctor view hides run IDs by default; hypothetical label persists in print/export; missing fields name field, reason and owner; conflicting evidence stays visible.

tasks.title: Synthetic fixtures and acceptance tests AT01-AT28
tasks.description: Synthetic scenario fixtures (never biological evidence) and an end-to-end test suite exercising the real importer, evaluator and export path for AT01-AT28 (§19).
tasks.details: Includes AT20 (731X frameshift identity) and AT28 (pitch check traces viability to RH_001 v3). Offline, deterministic.

tasks.title: Completion demonstration and operator guide
tasks.description: Offline demo script for §19.1: import candidate, explain why the real plan cannot freeze, preview branches, freeze a labelled synthetic fixture, ingest a synthetic outcome, review and successor, sanitized export, deterministic replay. Operator guide and architecture decision record (§23).
tasks.details: Demo must not mark the actual MVA plan as experimentally validated.

tasks.title: M5 pilot readiness: scientific review of the real plan
tasks.description: Scientific review of the real MVA plan, lab feasibility and predeclared evaluation (§21 M5, §22).
tasks.details: Requires human owners: assay methods and thresholds, meaningful effects, model availability, exposure plausibility, patient-relevant goals. Engineering prepares the named-blocker list; it cannot supply these answers.

tasks.title: M6 numerical adapters and permissioned node pilot
tasks.description: Reviewed simulation adapter and one permissioned evidence-node pilot (P1, §11.2, §12, §21 M6).
tasks.details: Requires validated models, parameters and verified dataset rights; out of scope for P0.
